_comment: Copy to fleet.json. This file is WHICH MACHINES this deployment watches.
It holds no secrets — HOST_<ID>_TOKEN in the environment supplies those —
so a private deployment repo can commit it.
teg    a Flask dashboard API, shared bearer
local  the machine this module runs on — /proc, /sys, docker.sock,
no origin and no token, because there is nothing to dial
mute lists alert kinds this host should never raise. See ALERT_KINDS in
laptop under load and means a failed fan on a server.
A gaming laptop runs its CPU and GPU hot under load by design, so loq
mutes both temperature rules and the throttle counter. The same numbers
on a server would mean a failed fan, which is why muting is per host.
